jobs.description: Are you detail-oriented and interested in warehouse and logistics operations? DHL Supply Chain in Weert is looking for a Stock Control Officer to monitor stock levels, manage inventory, and investigate stock discrepancies. Join our team and contribute to efficient warehouse operations! Who are we looking for? You are accurate, proactive, and well organised. You have an eye for detail, enjoy analysing information, and can work independently as well as part of a team. You take responsibility for your work and communicate effectively with colleagues. Your skills and experience: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Good spoken and written English. Interest in warehouse operations, logistics, and inventory management. Experience in stock control or warehouse administration is an advantage, but not required. What do we offer? Gross hourly wage of €15.32. Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per working day. Fully paid training and certificates, including EPT, OPT, forklift, and reach truck. Opportunities for career development and internal promotion. A stable, full-time position at DHL Supply Chain. Functieomschrijving As a Stock Control Officer, you will help keep warehouse inventory accurate and organised. You will monitor stock levels, perform inventory checks, and investigate differences between physical stock and system records. You will work closely with warehouse employees to resolve stock issues and improve inventory accuracy. Your responsibilities: Monitor stock levels and inventory movements. Perform stock counts and cycle counts. Identify and investigate stock discrepancies. Update inventory data in the Warehouse Management System (WMS). Support warehouse staff with stock-related questions. Improve stock accuracy and warehouse processes. Ensure inventory procedures are followed correctly.

As a Production Worker, no two days are the same! You’ll take on a variety of tasks such as operating the production line, packing and unpacking products, and monitoring progress. Notice a minor malfunction? You’ll take care of it right away. You’ll also make sure that pallets and products are properly labeled and that your workspace stays clean and organized. In addition, there’s an opportunity to work in other departments, making your job even more diverse and dynamic.What we ask from you:- Are you available to start full-time right away? Perfect!-  You bring a positive attitude and help create a great atmosphere at work;-  You’re physically fit and enjoy being active throughout the day;-  You speak good English – if you also speak Polish, that’s a plus;-  Working neatly and accurately comes naturally to you.

What will you be doing?As a Production Employee, you play an important role in the preparation and packaging of food products. Together with your team, you help keep production running efficiently while making sure quality and safety standards are met. Your attention to detail and proactive attitude contribute to a smooth workflow and a well-organized production environment.Your responsibilities include:• Packing and preparing finished products so they are ready for shipment;• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production equipment during the manufacturing process;• Performing quality checks on products, packaging, and labeling to ensure all requirements are met;• Keeping the work area clean, tidy, and compliant with hygiene and safety regulations;• Collaborating with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production goals and meet daily schedules.Functie-eisen:What are we looking for?• You have a good command of either English, Dutch, or both, allowing you to understand procedures and work safely within a production environment;• You enjoy working in different locations and are open to being assigned to various production facilities throughout the region;• You are flexible regarding working hours and can work rotating shifts, including mornings, afternoons, evenings, and nights for 16 to 32 hours per week;• You are eager to learn new skills, adapt quickly to changing tasks, and become familiar with different production equipment;• You have an eye for detail, value quality, and actively contribute to a clean, organized, and safe workplace.
